name: design-skills
description: Fourteen skills for enterprise product design work. Work out what the problem actually is, sketch it as a breadboard, try two or three solution directions and pick one with a binary fit check inside a fixed time budget, wireframe the screens when layout turns out to be the real question, diagram what people are stuck on, then write it up as a proposal someone can approve or decline. A context-intake skill distils raw material — transcripts, emails, documents — into the context repository the others read from, and promotes what outlives the project to a durable hub. A pitch skill works out how to explain a decision that has already been made, and renderers turn that into a scrollytelling explainer, a Figma Slides deck or a local tldraw canvas. Utilities capture how you write and what your work looks like, and strip the AI tells out of anything drafted for a reader.
